description:
An excellent opportunity to acquire a three-bedroom maisonette apartment, ideally situated within a modern development on the outskirts of Penrith.

Offering a superb location with easy access to both the Lake District National Park and the M6 motorway, this property is perfectly suited to a wide range of buyers, from first-time purchasers to investors and those seeking a low-maintenance home. Further benefiting from no onward chain, it presents an ideal hassle-free purchase.

The apartment features its own entrance with a private hallway, a spacious open-plan living area, creating a bright and contemporary space ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The seamless layout incorporates the living, dining and kitchen areas, enhancing the feeling of space and sociability. A striking bay window floods the room with natural light while also enjoying far-reaching views across the surrounding area. The floor above comprises 3 bedrooms and a bathroom.

Positioned on the fringe of Penrith, the property offers the perfect balance of convenience and tranquillity. Residents can enjoy easy access to the town centre and its excellent range of amenities, shops and transport links, while the nearby Lake District provides endless opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor pursuits amidst some of the country’s most spectacular scenery.

Thoughtfully designed throughout, the apartment combines practicality with modern style, offering comfortable and versatile accommodation ideally suited to contemporary living.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, location and flexibility on offer.

Directions From Penrith town centre follow the B5288 over the railway bridge onto Norfolk Road, through Castletown. Take the left hand fork onto Greystoke Road and left into Greystoke Park Road. Turn left and at the bottom of the road turn right. Windsor House is at the end of the road.
